name: Tenth District Hero — second ability: legendary, named Mileva, the Stalwart, 5/5, other creatures indestructible
notes: Sweep group 2 (2026-10-07). "If this creature is a Detective, it becomes a legendary creature named Mileva, the Stalwart, it has base power and toughness 5/5, and it gains "Other creatures you control have indestructible."" parsed to nothing: only the first "it" was read as the Hero, and nothing read "named" or "legendary". The fired text is split into one sentence a clause about the source; "becomes a legendary creature named N" sets the name and adds Legendary and keeps the creature types (CR 205.1a).
